claim: For an opted-out type whose members have Key attributes, the new early continue skips the later key-recording and duplicate-key checks. Two members with the same key therefore produce no MsgPack005, despite the requirement that analyzer diagnostics continue to work and the new README explicitly promising key-uniqueness validation. The same pattern exists in both changed member-processing loops.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.SuppressSourceGenerationAnalyzerReceiptTests.SuppressedType_ReportsDuplicateKeys. The test compiles a SuppressSourceGeneration=true type with two [Key(0)] members and asserts MsgPack005; on the changed code both members are skipped before duplicate detection, so the assertion exposes the missing diagnostic.

claim: The early continue also bypasses the remaining processing of every keyed member, including the later recursive collection of that member's type. Consequently an opted-out type with a [Key] member whose type violates the serializability contract no longer gets MsgPack003, contradicting both the acceptance criterion and the README's explicit statement that member types are still validated.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.SuppressSourceGenerationAnalyzerReceiptTests.SuppressedType_ReportsUnserializableMemberType. It uses a SuppressSourceGeneration=true type with a keyed member of an unannotated, non-serializable class and asserts MsgPack003; the changed control flow skips member-type collection and the assertion exposes the missing diagnostic.

claim: When source generation is suppressed, a member carrying an attribute derived from KeyAttribute is skipped before its member type is collected. Consequently, a referenced type that lacks [MessagePackObject] no longer receives MsgPack003 (and any later member-specific checks are likewise bypassed), contrary to the requirement that analyzer diagnostics continue to work with suppression enabled. The same early continue was added to both the field and property paths.

The equivalent field case is skipped at line 921.

claim: With SuppressSourceGeneration=true, a member using a KeyAttribute-derived attribute is skipped before the member's MessagePackFormatter attribute is examined, so formatter-related analyzer diagnostics are silently lost for that member even though analyzers are supposed to remain active.
